slides.title: Green CI. **Wrong fix.**
slides.sub: Production said one thing. My laptop said another. I shipped anyway.

slides.label: Habit 1: close enough
slides.caption: I reproduce it locally and get **US-ASCII** instead.
slides.say: Same neighbourhood. Must be the locale.

slides.label: Habit 1: the result
slides.caption: I ship a locale fix. CI goes green.
slides.note: Wrong twice over. It looked done for about a day.

slides.label: Habit 2: exact match
slides.caption: The local repro has to say **UTF-8** too. It doesn't.
slides.say: That gap is the finding, not a footnote.

slides.label: Habit 2: the fix
slides.caption: Find where the byte comes in. Scrub it at that one place.
slides.say: Plus a test that writes the exact byte.

slides.text: Reproduce the error in front of you, not one that resembles it.
slides.save: 💾 Save this for your next bug hunt
